replaces.idea: A wall-mounted metal card rack holding slotted index cards with red-inked edge tabs to record dirty heap regions.
A three-lens signal lantern on a short iron post with dark, grey, and glowing white lenses.
A counter-mounted spring-loaded ticket dispenser with a brass pointer arm advancing along a paper roll.
A wide cast-iron key-duplicating board on floor legs with brass key blanks hanging on numbered hooks.
A brass referee's whistle hanging from a wall-mounted iron hook with a short lanyard cord.

new.name: Tri-Color Signal
new.depicts: A compact three-lens signal lantern bolted to a short iron floor post, with a dark bottom lens, a grey middle lens, and a lit white top lens.
new.focal: The three stacked circular lenses (black, grey, white)

new.name: Bump Dispenser
new.depicts: A counter-mounted metal ticket dispenser on a flat base, holding a thick paper roll with a brass pointer arm resting at the advancing tear edge.
new.focal: The brass pointer arm at the paper roll's tear edge

new.name: Dirty Card Rack
new.depicts: A wall-mounted sheet-metal card rack with two rows of slotted index cards, two of which stick up with bright red-inked top tabs.
new.focal: The two red-tabbed dirty cards protruding from the slots

new.name: Intern Key Board
new.depicts: A wide cast-iron key-duplicating board standing on two floor legs, with a row of identical brass key blanks hanging from numbered hooks along a top rail.
new.focal: The row of identical brass key blanks on hooks

new.name: Safepoint Whistle
new.depicts: A rounded brass referee's whistle hanging from a wall-mounted iron peg by a short dark lanyard loop.
new.focal: The brass whistle body and pea chamber

rework.redesign: Redraw as a low wooden seedling flat on short feet with a small brass tag on the front rim and four tiny green-and-yellow sprouts growing out of dark soil.
